prompt: Create a dreamy pastel anime birthday illustration of Hatsune Miku seen from behind on a sunlit flower-filled balcony garden. She stands slightly left of center in a white off-shoulder ankle-length dress with a pale aqua ribbon sash, holding a large bouquet of pink, white, and lavender flowers close to her chest. Give her extremely long flowing twin-tails in turquoise blue, trailing dramatically to the right in the breeze with many delicate strands and translucent highlights. The scene is soft, luminous, and ethereal, with a bright blue sky, warm sunlight from the upper right, lens flare, floating flower petals, bokeh, and a gentle celebratory mood. Include abundant pastel flowers: a floral arch or hanging blossoms in the upper left, a small round table at lower left with a white birthday cake topped by lit candles and tied with an aqua ribbon, a white balcony railing in the middle distance, and large blurred pink and purple foreground flowers on the right for depth. Use a high-detail polished 3D-anime / Vocaloid fan-art look, delicate fabric motion, soft bloom, rim lighting, shallow depth of field, and a pale pink-blue-white color palette. Add glowing handwritten pink text along the lower left and bottom center reading exactly: “Happy Birthday, Miku! You bring me more happiness than words can say, and I hope just as much finds its way back to you. — Aug. 31, 2026”. Keep the text integrated like a soft neon signature, legible but dreamy. Wide cinematic 16:9 composition, no watermark, no extra characters.

promptZh: 创作一幅梦幻般的粉彩动漫风格生日插画，展示 初音未来 在阳光明媚、鲜花盛开的阳台花园中的背影。她站在画面中心偏左的位置，身穿一件白色露肩及踝长裙，系着淡青色丝带腰带，怀中抱着一大束粉色、白色和淡紫色的花束。赋予她标志性的极长双马尾，发色为 青蓝色，在微风中向右飘逸，展现出细腻的发丝和半透明的高光效果。场景柔和、明亮且空灵，背景是湛蓝的天空，右上角洒下温暖的阳光，伴有镜头光晕、飘落的花瓣、虚化效果，营造出温馨的庆生氛围。画面中包含丰富的粉彩花卉：左上角有花拱门或垂挂的花朵，左下角有一张小圆桌，桌上摆放着插有蜡烛并系着青色丝带的白色生日蛋糕，中景处为白色阳台栏杆，右侧前景有模糊的粉紫色大花以增加景深。采用高细节的精致 3D 动漫/Vocaloid 同人艺术风格，表现出细腻的织物动感、柔光效果、轮廓光和浅景深，整体色调为淡粉、淡蓝与白色。在左下角及底部中心添加发光的粉色手写文字，内容必须为：“Happy Birthday, Miku! You bring me more happiness than words can say, and I hope just as much finds its way back to you. — Aug. 31, 2026”。文字需与画面融合，呈现出柔和的霓虹灯签名效果，清晰且梦幻。采用 16:9 宽屏电影构图，无水印，无额外角色。
